scope: 用户已选 A 深空指挥舱，正式主页已重做，强化动态星场、三维网络球、轨道数据流、流星与鼠标视差。

directions.name: 深空指挥舱
directions.type: 中文无衬线大标题 / 精简等宽技术注释
directions.layout: 左侧姓名与主张，右侧大型神经球体，向下进入项目档案与实习时间线。
directions.principle: 把跨界面、服务端、数据与 AI 的工程连接能力变成中心轨道视觉。
directions.motion: 轨道缓慢旋转；交互时显示技术节点，遵守减少动态效果设置。

directions.name: 黑客工作站
directions.type: 等宽英文 / 易读中文黑体
directions.layout: 文件树与标签页围绕主要内容，首屏个人介绍，下方以终端日志呈现工作经历。
directions.principle: 用开发环境的交互语言组织真实项目，不伪造系统监控或贡献统计。
directions.motion: 短启动呈现；文件夹切换和命令按钮均提供普通点击方式。

directions.name: 轨道实验室
directions.type: 大字号几何英文 / 清晰中文无衬线
directions.layout: 大留白双栏首屏，右侧金属计算核心，项目以工程目录方式展示。
directions.principle: 以银白工业材质和蓝图语言表现极客感，避免与常见暗色作品集同质。
directions.motion: 鼠标轻微视差；移动端使用静态资产。

review: 三套方案以同一份真实经历为内容基础，分别在宇宙轨道、代码编辑器和工业蓝图上建立视觉特征。首屏使用实物感主视觉，正文保持阅读优先。所有方案均需响应式、键盘焦点和 reduced-motion 支持。

prompts.name: 深空指挥舱
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished high-fidelity desktop personal portfolio WEBSITE SCREENSHOT, landscape 1536x1024 composition, single website only, no device mockup, no browser chrome, no presentation border. A deliberately ambitious geeky sci-fi mission-control visual identity for Chinese full stack developer 曹泽祯, alias ZHEN. THIS IS A REAL DEVELOPER PORTFOLIO, all displayed content must relate to the supplied projects; no fabricated metrics, awards, job titles, revenue, activity counts, or system telemetry pretending to be real.
Direction A: Deep space command deck. Palette midnight #030914, navy #0b1d32, electric cyan #42e8f4, ice #eaf8ff, restrained periwinkle #7485ff. Spectacular central-right luminous three-dimensional glass neural sphere made of layered orbital arcs and delicate graph nodes, with subtle starfield. Treat the orb as a beautiful abstract visual, not a claimed product screenshot. Crisp futuristic but legible type, oversized beautiful Chinese headline left. Precise thin cyan brackets, restrained glass layering, expansive editorial spacing; not a generic SaaS card grid. Nav top brand 'ZHEN / 曹泽祯', links '项目' '经历' '技术' '联系', small GitHub button. Hero left small '曹泽祯 · 全栈开发工程师', enormous headline exactly '把想法，' next line '构建成真实系统。' Supporting text '微信小程序 / Java / Node.js / Python' and '连接业务、数据与 AI，把每一层都做扎实。' Two clear buttons '探索项目' and '工作经历'. Under hero a fine technology strip 'Spring Boot   Node.js   MySQL   Neo4j   ArkTS   XGBoost'. Bottom visible beginning of project section titled '构建记录' with horizontal previews of '龙庆峡 / 文旅票务平台' and '野一下 / 户外活动平台', fine schematic imagery, Java + Spring Boot and Node.js + MySQL respective stack labels. Large orb should dominate 45% screen, quiet dark backdrop with readable real web content. Impeccably art directed, exceptionally sharp interface detail, generous margins, strong asymmetrical composition. No cyberpunk city, no person, no robot, no fake dashboards of arbitrary numbers, no watermarks. Exact Chinese text as supplied.
